examined_formations.title: CHINA_HAINAN_ZERO_EMPLOYEE_SOLAR_SPV_WITH_AUDITED_POSITIVE_CASHFLOW_AND_100_PERCENT_TRANSFER_PATH_BUT_NO_EXECUTED_CONTROL_CHANGE
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: South Grid Energy's current 2026 disclosure identifies Nandian (Chengmai) New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. as a wholly owned solar-project operator and reports 2025 audited operating revenue of RMB14,207,675.96, net profit of RMB4,679,109.21 and operating cashflow of RMB5,046,858.09.

The current public-exchange packet offers 100% of the same entity for RMB82.1275 million and reports zero employees, 2025 audited revenue RMB14.2077 million and net profit RMB4.6791 million, plus positive 2026 year-to-date revenue and profit.
The transaction packet explicitly says the lender requires repayment or lender-approved refinancing before the equity transfer and actual-controller change can be completed.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The entity holds and operates a photovoltaic-project position with real audited cash generation and a formally transferable corporate control package.
The transfer valuation depends materially on electricity-subsidy assumptions and collection timing, while the entity carries a large bank-loan balance.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The parent is attempting a full control exit rather than merely selling a minority financial interest.
The lender has asserted a concrete control-change condition, demonstrating that legal equity transferability does not by itself make the control position immediately callable.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This packet is stronger than Scan 111 because low headcount, audited positive revenue, positive profit, positive operating cashflow and a 100% control path all bind to the same entity.
As of 2026-09-22 the available current evidence is still a listing/transfer process, not a completed transaction result, so post-transfer economic continuity is not observable.

Zero employees does not establish zero human delivery: solar operations, maintenance, grid coordination, financing and compliance may be outsourced or parent-supported, and the public packet does not quantify replacement labor/service cost.
The economic value is materially tied to capital infrastructure, subsidy assumptions, grid revenue and financing rather than a demonstrated machine-operated routing/control asset.
economic_signal: 2025 audited revenue RMB14.2077 million, net profit RMB4.6791 million and operating cashflow RMB5.0469 million.
Current 100% listing price RMB82.1275 million; bank-loan balance disclosed at approximately RMB65.6523 million as of February 2026.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The decisive control surface is ownership of the solar project company plus project/grid/finance relationships, not a general-purpose routing layer.
Control change is creditor-conditioned and valuation is subsidy-sensitive.
No independently evidenced operator-owned compounding demand/data/distribution asset distinct from the physical energy project is shown.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_QINGDAO_ONE_EMPLOYEE_HOTEL_PROPERTY_WRAPPER_WITH_AUDITED_PROFIT_AND_OUTSOURCED_OPERATION_BUT_REPEAT_UNEXECUTED_100_PERCENT_LISTING
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: Qingdao local reporting states that Qingdao Zhongtian Hotel Co., Ltd.'s hotel property is leased as a whole to a professional hotel-management team for daily operation.
The same current reporting gives 2025 revenue of RMB2.8272 million and net profit RMB1.4513 million and states the first 2026 RMB100 million control-transfer listing expired without a buyer.

The September 2026 public-exchange packet relists 100% at RMB83.7811 million, reports one employee, and reports 2025 audited revenue RMB2.8272 million/net profit RMB1.4513 million plus 2026-H1 revenue RMB1.991 million/net profit RMB1.1762 million.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The company controls scarce Qingdao historic-core hotel real estate while daily hospitality operation is delegated to a professional team.
Low internal headcount and positive company-level profit therefore coexist with external human operations.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The owner has repeatedly attempted a 100% equity exit after the first listing failed to attract a buyer.
The operating model uses whole-property leasing/professional management rather than internal staff-heavy hotel delivery.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This is genuine founder-light company-level operation but not proof of machine-delegatable value creation: the hotel service is performed by a professional human operating team.
The audited revenue packet does not disclose whether company revenue is primarily lease income, hotel-operating receipts or another mix, so end-customer cashflow must not be inferred.
The first transfer round failed and the current lower-price 100% listing remains an offer rather than an executed control change.
The dominant scarcity is capital-intensive urban real estate and location, not a reusable operator routing/data/control asset.
economic_signal: 2025 audited revenue RMB2.8272 million and net profit RMB1.4513 million.
2026-H1 revenue RMB1.991 million and net profit RMB1.1762 million.
Current 100% listing price RMB83.7811 million after an earlier RMB100 million listing did not transact.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The company controls the property while a professional hotel team controls recurring hospitality execution.
A buyer would acquire scarce real estate/control, but the current packet does not establish an independently compounding distribution or data edge.
Capital ownership and outsourced human service, rather than machine routing, explain the low internal headcount.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_YONGTAI_SIX_EMPLOYEE_WASTEWATER_CONCESSION_WITH_AUDITED_POSITIVE_ECONOMICS_AND_GOVERNMENT_APPROVED_RIGHTS_CONTINUITY_BUT_UNEXECUTED_TRANSFER
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A current 2026 operator procurement notice identifies Yongtai County Guozhen Water Treatment Co., Ltd. as the operator of a 10,000-ton-per-day township wastewater-treatment plant and purchases one year of monitoring/testing service.

The September 2026 public-exchange packet offers 100% of the same company, reports six employees, 2025 audited revenue RMB3.2024 million and net profit RMB57,600, and 2026 through August revenue RMB2.132 million and net profit RMB285,200.
The transfer packet states the project concession runs through October 2043 and cites the local housing authority's written consent to the 100% equity transfer.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The company holds a long-duration municipal wastewater concession that remains with the company after a completed equity transfer.
The transfer price is RMB6.6616 million, but the buyer must also accept substantial related-party debt and guarantee concession-performance obligations.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The live operator externally procures specialized monitoring/testing while retaining only six employees, showing some bounded delegation of technical functions.
The sellers are attempting a complete control exit with explicit government-approved rights continuity rather than a minority investment.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Rights continuity is unusually strong: the public packet says the company remains the concession-performance entity after transfer and the buyer must guarantee the concession obligations.
The transaction is nevertheless only a current listing; no completed control transfer or post-transfer operating period exists as of 2026-09-22.

Wastewater treatment remains physical, regulated infrastructure with staff, plant operation, testing, maintenance and compliance obligations; outsourcing one testing function does not make delivery machine-native.
The buyer must address approximately RMB17.3791 million of debt to the sellers/affiliates within one year, so the small headline equity price understates control-capital burden.
economic_signal: 2025 audited revenue RMB3.2024 million and net profit RMB57,600.
2026 through August revenue RMB2.132 million and net profit RMB285,200.
100% listing price RMB6.6616 million plus disclosed related-party debt of approximately RMB17.3791 million.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The decisive control asset is a municipal concession and physical plant, with government and regulatory obligations embedded in the control position.
The concession survives the contemplated equity transfer, but the buyer must guarantee performance and continue employee obligations.
No separate machine-owned customer acquisition/routing/data control surface is evidenced.
